title: Up the stairs with your hands full: the 5 rung squat ladder
caption: Exercises to make stairs easier, in five rungs from Partial Squat to Split Squat, each with the test that says you are ready for the next one. Start on the rung that feels steady and climb when the test says so. Save the ladder for the next laundry day.

overlays.text: If you grab the rail when your hands are full, this is for you.
Partial Squat. 10 reps. Sit back a few inches, then stand tall.
Half Squat. 10 reps. Sit back halfway down, then stand tall.

scenes.footer: Ready when every rep hits the same depth.

overlays.text: Air Squat. 10 reps. Feet hip width, sit down between your heels, stand tall.

scenes.footer: Ready when the pause is steady.

overlays.text: Paused Squat. 8 reps. Squat down, hold for two seconds, stand up.

scenes.footer: This is the stairs with a full laundry basket, no hand on the rail.

overlays.text: Split Squat. 8 reps each side. One foot forward, lower the back knee, stand up.
The top rung takes months, not a week.
